contentText:
@starlink :

Starlink says that it has 12M+ “active customers” across 160+ countries, territories, and other markets, up from 9M in December 2025   —  Starlink is connecting more than 12M active customers with high-speed internet across 160+ countries, territories and many other markets. Thank you to all our customers around the world! 🛰️🌎❤️ → https://starlink.com/12M [image]
